facts.value: Each compulsory and elective module is described in accordance with the regulations as part of the curriculum.
facts.original_value: Zu jedem Pflicht- und Wahlpflichtmodul enthält Anlage 3 eine Modulbeschreibung nach Maßgabe von § 14 RO.

facts.value: Changes to the module handbook that do not affect the content of the module descriptions may be made by a department council resolution before the beginning of a semester.
